code.source: public record User(int Id, string Name);

questions.prompt: What does `{ get; init; }` on a property allow that `{ get; set; }` restricts?

options.text: Allows setting the property during object initialization (`new User { Id = 1 }`) or `with`, then makes it immutable afterward

questions.prompt: What does `with` expression (`var u2 = u1 with { Name = "Bob" };`) do on a `record`?

options.text: Creates a shallow copy of `u1` with only `Name` updated

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about `IDisposable` and `using` in C#. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `using` turns a class into a value type
`using var conn = OpenConn();` calls `conn.Dispose()` automatically at the end of the enclosing scope (even on exceptions)
Used for deterministic cleanup of unmanaged resources (files, DB connections, sockets, locks)

questions.prompt: Match each LINQ method to what it does.

columns.label: Immediately returns first element or `default` if empty

questions.prompt: What does 'deferred execution' mean in LINQ (`IEnumerable<T>`)?

options.text: The query only defines the pipeline; it executes each time you iterate (`foreach`, `.ToList()`, `.Any()`)

questions.prompt: How does `IQueryable<T>` (e.g., Entity Framework Core) differ from `IEnumerable<T>`?

options.text: `IQueryable<T>` builds an Expression Tree that providers translate into SQL/remote queries; `IEnumerable<T>` runs delegates in-memory

questions.prompt: What is the difference between `throw;` and `throw ex;` inside a `catch (Exception ex)` block?

options.text: `throw;` preserves the original stack trace; `throw ex;` resets the stack trace to the `catch` line, hiding the real failure origin

questions.prompt: What does `catch (HttpRequestException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.NotFound)` use?

options.text: An exception filter (`when`), which inspects the condition *before* unwinding the stack

questions.prompt: How does an `interface` differ from an `abstract class` in C#?

options.text: A class can implement multiple interfaces but inherit from at most one base class; abstract classes can hold instance state/fields and constructors
Abstract classes cannot have abstract methods

questions.prompt: What does `virtual` + `override` enable vs `new` method hiding on a derived class?

options.text: `virtual`/`override` enables polymorphic dispatch based on runtime type; `new` hides the base method statically based on variable type

questions.prompt: What does `sealed` on a class (`public sealed class TokenService`) do?

options.text: Prevents any class from inheriting from it (and allows the .NET JIT to devirtualize calls!)

questions.prompt: What does pattern matching `obj switch { int n when n > 0 => "pos", string s => s, _ => "other" }` demonstrate?

options.text: Type + relational/guard pattern matching in a concise `switch` expression

questions.prompt: Select all built-in generic delegate types in `System`. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `Func<T, TResult>` (last type param is return type)

questions.prompt: What does `where T : class, new()` on a generic class `Repo<T>` constrain?

options.text: `T` must be a reference type with a public parameterless constructor

questions.prompt: What is `required` modifier on a property (`public required string ApiKey { get; init; }`) in C# 11?

options.text: Forces callers constructing the object to initialize `ApiKey` in the object initializer at compile time

questions.prompt: What does `yield return item;` inside a method returning `IEnumerable<T>` create?

options.text: A compiler-generated lazy state-machine iterator yielding elements one by one on demand

questions.prompt: What does `SelectMany` do in LINQ?
What is the difference between `.Any()` and `.Count() > 0` on an `IEnumerable<T>`?

options.text: `.Any()` stops at the very first element ($O(1)$), whereas `.Count()` may iterate the entire sequence ($O(n)$) if it's not an `ICollection`

questions.prompt: Match each C# class/member feature to its effect.

columns.label: Adds static helper methods callable as instance syntax on existing types
Splits a single class definition across multiple files (great for source generators)
Declares constructor parameters directly on the class/struct header (C# 12)

questions.prompt: What does `IReadOnlyList<T>` in a public API return type prevent compared to `List<T>`?

options.text: Prevents callers from mutating (`Add`/`Clear`) your internal list while still exposing `.Count` and `[i]`

questions.prompt: What is a closure capture pitfall in `for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) actions.Add(() => i);`?

options.text: All lambdas capture the *same* loop variable `i`, so calling them after the loop prints `3, 3, 3` (copy to a local `int copy = i;` inside the loop!)

questions.prompt: What does `StringComparison.Ordinal` vs `CurrentCulture` matter for in `.OrderBy` or `Dictionary<string, T>`?

options.text: `Dictionary<string, T>` defaults to `Ordinal` (fast byte-level comparison), whereas `string.Compare` defaults to `CurrentCulture`

questions.prompt: What does `record struct Point(int X, int Y);` create vs `record Point(int X, int Y);`?

options.text: `record struct` is a value type (allocated inline/stack, mutable unless `readonly record struct`); `record` (`record class`) is a reference type

questions.prompt: Select all valid pattern-matching features in modern C#. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Property patterns: `user is { Role: "Admin", IsActive: true }`
Regex patterns: `str is /^abc$/` (C# doesn't have regex literal patterns in `is`)

questions.prompt: What does `Dictionary.GetValueOrDefault(key, fallback)` do?

options.text: Returns the value if present, or `fallback` without modifying the dictionary

questions.prompt: What does `GroupBy` in LINQ return?

options.text: An `IEnumerable<IGrouping<TKey, TElement>>` where each group has `.Key` and enumerates its matching elements

questions.prompt: What does `static` on a lambda (`static x => x * 2` in C# 9+) enforce?

options.text: Compile-time guarantee that the lambda captures NO local variables or `this` (preventing accidental closure allocations)

questions.prompt: What does `[CallerMemberName]` attribute on an optional parameter (`[CallerMemberName] string caller = ""`) do?

options.text: Automatically fills in the calling method/property name at compile time (used in `INotifyPropertyChanged` and logging)

questions.prompt: What is the difference between `.First()` and `.Single()` in LINQ?

options.text: `.First()` returns the first element (even if more exist); `.Single()` throws if there are 0 OR >1 elements

What does `System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(obj)` serialize by default?

options.text: Public properties (and fields only if `[JsonInclude]` or `IncludeFields = true` is configured)

questions.prompt: What does `covariant` generic `out T` (`interface IReadOnlyList<out T>`) allow?

options.text: Assigning `IReadOnlyList<Dog>` to `IReadOnlyList<Animal>` safely because `T` only appears in output positions

questions.prompt: What does `ObjectDisposedException` indicate?

options.text: Code attempted to use a resource (`Stream`, `DbContext`, `HttpClient`) after `.Dispose()` was already called

questions.prompt: Why should `HttpClient` NOT be created inside `using var client = new HttpClient();` per request in .NET?

options.text: Disposing `HttpClient` per request exhausts OS sockets (`TIME_WAIT` port exhaustion) and misses DNS updates; reuse via `IHttpClientFactory` or `SocketsHttpHandler`

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about `Span<T>` / `ReadOnlySpan<T>` basics. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Can be stored inside `async` method state machines across `await` in C# 12 (no, `ref struct`s cannot cross `await`!)
Represents a contiguous slice of memory (managed array, native buffer, or stack `stackalloc`) with zero heap allocation
Is a `ref struct`, meaning it lives on the stack and cannot be boxed or stored as a field on a normal `class`
